consultations.text: INTUITION (T5 consult 1, MODEL claude-fable-5 max, session 3 — new intuition instance): PROVENANCE DISCLOSURE: this instance inherited session context naming T1's damage-as-key and T6's possession-trap solutions and knows T5 baselined at 0%, but has NOT read T5's template docstring or generator code. Partially-informed discovery, disclosed as such. Discipline unchanged: every carried-over pattern is a HYPOTHESIS requiring in-world confirmation before any override. First move: read the opening before touching anything.

INTUITION (T5 consult 2): Antechamber, a 'dark seed' (item 1) and a 'warm charm' (item 2), corridor east toward a visible gate. T6-pattern hypothesis: charms are candidate traps; T1-pattern hypothesis: gates may want a state, not a key. Neither transfers without evidence (bindings are per-seed/template). Plan: probe the far gate EMPTY-HANDED first at full hp — the refusal text is the cheapest instrument in this engine; leave both items on the floor until the gate has spoken.

INTUITION (T5 consult 3): The way east is SEALED — 'You can't find a way through here' x7 at (10,3), mechanics counter says 0/3 discovered. So the passage itself is mechanism-gated and my only levers are the two floor items. Hypothesis menu (cheapest evidence first): (a) carrying the warm charm opens the way — charm-as-key, the benign inversion of T6's possession trap; (b) eating the dark seed changes state; (c) planting the seed AT the barrier (drop there) grows the way through. Experiment 1 = (a): pick up the charm, return to the barrier, step east; every result including refusal text is evidence.

INTUITION (T5 consult 4): Charm-carried passage attempt REFUSED — charm-as-key dead at this barrier (kept as hypothesis for the far gate). Next-cheapest: the dark seed. A seed's verb affinity is PLANT — experiment 2 = carry it to the barrier and drop it there (plant-the-way); experiment 3 fallback = eat it. Fetching the seed.

INTUITION (T5 consult 5): Plant-at-barrier refused too. Experiment 3: EAT the dark seed and watch state — 'dark' priced as possible self-damage (T1's mottled-fruit rhyme); at hp 100 with no other hazard visible that price is bounded and this world has exactly two levers, one now spent of its cheap uses. Also queued: interact ON the barrier cell (verb sweep completes the option menu).

INTUITION (T5 consult 6): THE SEED WAS THE LAMP — eating it cost 15 HP and REVEALED the hidden middle zone (mechanics 2/3): reveal-by-sacrifice, a genuinely new mechanic class (T1 spent damage on a gate, here damage bought INFORMATION/topology). The charm remains in hand and untested. Now probe the east gate carrying it; if it refuses, the T6 possession lesson (drop before the gate) is the queued counter — testable in one drop.

INTUITION (T5 consult 7): G1 yielded (mechanics 3/3) — but the pass is CONFOUNDED: I arrived wounded (85) AND carrying the charm, so damage-key vs charm-key is not separated by this line. Logging the ambiguity; post-win probe branch owed (retry G1 empty-handed at 100 vs wounded-no-charm). Pressing east to the goal.

INTUITION (T5 consult 8, post-win probe verdict): branch probe at the true crossing (results/e21b_live/T5_s0_probe_nocharm.json): wounded WITHOUT the charm G1 HOLDS FIRM; with it (same hp) it yielded => G1 is CHARM-KEYED — possession REQUIRED, the exact inversion of T6's possession trap. Full-HP arrival is unreachable on this seed (the reveal costs 15), so the wound is a cost, not the key. The T5/T6 pair is a defeasibility test: an agent that compiled T6 into the RULE 'never pick up' fails T5; an agent that holds it as a per-world HYPOTHESIS (as consult 3 did) passes both. Mechanic set closed 3/3: seed = reveal-by-sacrifice; seed-eat = hp price; gate = charm-key.
